scope: 16 historical development contexts, eight per task; mechanistic follow-up informed by earlier pilots, not protected confirmation or a physical-action success test
precision: FP32 with TF32 disabled; frozen weights, once encoded fixed contexts and goals
fresh_seed: candidate_seed XOR 0x40000000; exact native private-RNG initial-sampler parity as in action_condition_protocol.json
coherent_counterfactual: Only raw H3 action at global index2 is replaced by candidate(i+1) modulo300's H3 action; all other action timesteps, context and target remain fixed
addressing: Verified context window2: global H3 action appears at predictor call3 z[:,1] and call4 z[:,0], then leaves the window; condition is the pointwise Linear20-to-400 action encoder output, not proprio or the visual residual
subspace: FP64 thin SVD of literal frozen action_encoder.weight; retain s>1e-6*s_max, record all singular values, rank and projector residuals. Exact affine action-input range up to this numerical tolerance; not an estimated global activation manifold or a dormant downstream circuit
random_controls: One private-generator 400D standard Gaussian per candidate/layer/bank; its range projection, orthogonal-complement projection, and original vector are each normalized in FP64 to that candidate's donor-delta L2, cast to FP32 and added. Three controls share their underlying Gaussian draw. Record delivered norms and subspace residuals; fail positive-target relative norm error>1e-5; handle zero norms explicitly without dropping candidates
random_seed: SHA256('action-counterfactual-v1|task|episode|bank|layer') first16 hexadecimal characters interpreted unsigned and masked to63 bits
metrics: Per-candidate squared forecast distance to coherent counterfactual and native-to-counterfactual denominator at H3,H4,H6; visual, proprio, and official weighted combination. Full H6 goal-cost arrays and actual top10 indices for visual/proprio/official objectives; tie-aware native-rank agreement and centered score changes
official_weight: visual embedding MSE +0.1*proprio embedding MSE; reproduce unchanged upstream objective exactly
donor_fidelity: R=1-mean_candidate(MSE(patch,coherent))/mean_candidate(MSE(native,coherent)); form scenario-level ratio after averaging squared errors, not average of unstable candidate ratios. Official combines visual+0.1*proprio MSE. Retain negative R; zero denominator is explicitly undefined, never clipped or silently excluded
primary_contrasts: official donor fidelity: donor_persistent minus donor_h3
official donor fidelity: donor_h3 minus random_range
official native Spearman loss: random_range minus random_off_range
secondary: H3/H4 propagation, modality-specific responses, full-isotropic comparisons, elite changes, and all-block H3-only fidelity are descriptive; no physical truth or control-benefit claim
resampling_unit: Context within task, n8. The same paired bootstrap weights cover both banks, all layers and arms. Candidates, horizons and banks are not independent samples
intervals: Marginal percentile95 plus max-absolute centered-bootstrap-deviation bands across12 layer-by-bank cells per task/primary-contrast family. Six task-by-primary-contrast families use quantile1-0.05/6 for Bonferroni simultaneous95 coverage across all72 primary cells. Secondary summaries are explicitly exploratory
qualification: Verify literal encoder/context architecture and assigned GPU UUID, source/input/checkpoint/vendor hashes, native sampler parity, unchanged global RNG and parameter/buffer versions. Zero capture must reproduce full-horizon native forecasts and costs byte-exactly. All-block persistent patch must reproduce coherent raw-action counterfactual full-horizon forecasts and costs byte-exactly. H1/H2 unchanged. No numerical parity relaxation based on scientific outcomes
execution: One fixed tagged full case for engineering parities and timing only, then finish every registered context/arm. No efficacy-selected stopping, replacement scenario or arm deletion. Separate source hash and outputs from prior pilots
budget: Campaign ceiling65USD including prior spend, aggregate14USD/hour; phase C incremental guard10USD inclusive setup/compute/network with existing5USD cloud reserve. Reuse two qualified GPUs at approximately0.99USD/hour combined; no new rental needed for C
time_bound: New phase setup deadline2026-09-13T19:25Z, maximum60minutes scientific execution after first launch, operational stop20:30Z followed verified archive and release; any engineering extension must be explicit and bounded
preservation: Save source/protocol/manifest, actions, compact forecasts' per-candidate squared distances, all cost vectors/elites, norm/subspace audits, identity and completion receipts, and technical failure logs to verified durable cloud storage. Full forecast tensors computed but not retained; do not later claim availability
